requirement_limits.PRIV-03: Publication refusal verified; public publication not certified
requirement_limits.PRIV-05: Local rights flows verified; independent legal review and other class policies remain pending

protocol.statement: Manter WebSocket/STOMP conforme RT-01. Recorded owner reply in 07-03-SUMMARY; SSE proposal superseded. Session/origin/domain authorization and CONNECT CSRF retained.

ui.statement: Implement previously confirmed UI-D01..07 and existing Arena patterns under continuous execution authority; technical composition delegated. Draft/checker and full accessibility certification are not represented as independently approved or passed.

mvp_story.description: Owner ratification of the actual user story; no invented persona
mvp_story.statement: Existing D-15/16 story: visitor discovers and reads published-event chat; authenticated participant discovers and reads private global chat. Continuous phase authority covers this implementation; no invented persona or separate owner reply.

writing_contract.description: Unicode unit and authoritative rate-limit scope
writing_contract.statement: Executor technical choice under explicit continuous owner authority:280Unicode code points, exact unnormalized text; one new accepted message per actor per3seconds across all channels. This records delegated implementation, not a separate owner answer.

lifecycle.description: Definitive producer timestamps, cancellation and pending compensation
lifecycle.statement: Owner decision: cancelamento confirmado sem placar inicia a janela de duas horas para fechamento permanente do chat; compensacao pendente bloqueia o marco ate sua conclusao. Resultado, processamento completo e correcoes seguem D-30/D-31.

moderation_policy.description: Infraction/case identity, concurrency and reversal rules
moderation_policy.statement: D-17/D-18/D-19 governam o bloco: moderador atua somente no escopo concedido; ADMINISTRADOR_GERAL aplica suspensoes globais; denuncia nao pune automaticamente; a unidade de caso impede dupla sancao; revisao e anulacao sao novos fatos auditados; nenhuma acao altera saldo, ranking ou historico financeiro.

mute_policy.description: All chat channels; account version conflict refetch; only persisted writes acknowledged
mute_policy.statement: Executor concretizes cross-channel scope and synchronization semantics in PLAN under continuous owner authority. No separate human policy answer claimed.

legal.description: Owner-approved legal/privacy gate: retention by class, verified rights handling, restricted export, audited expurgo and pseudonymization.
legal.statement: Option 1 approved: complete legal/privacy gate for implementation. Retention is defined per data class; access, correction, objection, deletion, export and pseudonymization require verified-holder review by ADMINISTRADOR_GERAL. Expurgo is an audited disposition/projection operation and never mutates append-only facts. This does not authorize public pilot launch or claim independent legal-counsel review.

backup_operations.statement: Owner answered Autorizado to the proposed private local encrypted backup proof; public-pilot policy remains pending.

load_profile.statement: Owner: Ratificar esse perfil local. Measurement remains required; this decision is not evidence of capacity.

rules_preference.description: Storage/module/FK/retention and rules dismissal sync failure policy
rules_preference.statement: Conta resolvida no servidor no modulo chat; FK local_identity; GET/POST dismissed boolean-only; inativa/pausada pode dispensar; falha de sincronizacao permanece explicita; fechar nao e aceite juridico nem reabre por versao no piloto.

local_technical_scope.description: Complete remaining Phase7 technical work locally; publication remains blocked
local_technical_scope.statement: Owner: Concluir parte t?cnica local; manter publica??o bloqueada. Do not approve institutional identity or infer deployment authority.
